subject: Marketplace listing & regional bundling: proposal for AWS/Azure/GCP
messages:
From: Sandeep Rao <srao@amazon.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@gcppartners.com>, Leah Morgan <leah.m@nebula.ai>
Date: Tue, 12 May 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Marketplace listing scope & regional availability

Marcus —

Thanks again for taking a call yesterday. As we prep for Nebula Analytics' procurement review, they asked whether Redwood can be listed in the AWS Marketplace with: (a) a pay-as-you-go metered SKU, (b) an hourly reserved SKU for Dedicated capacity, and (c) a bring-your-own-license / private deployment listing option.

High level asks from Nebula:
- Start in us-east-1 and us-west-2; expand to eu-west-1 later in Q3.
- Clear SKU mapping so their SREs can automate provisioning.
- A listing that supports both metering (per-token or per-second compute) and reserved monthly commitments.

Can you confirm what we can realistically publish to AWS Marketplace by end of May (and any constraints for hourly vs monthly SKUs)? Also looping Emily since GCP's program has slightly different metering expectations and limits.

Sandeep
Marketplace Partnerships, AWS

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Sandeep Rao <srao@amazon.com>, Leah Morgan <leah.m@nebula.ai>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 13 May 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing scope & regional availability

Hi Sandeep — thanks for the clear ask. Putting an initial plan below and will flag questions for the GCP/Azure models.

Summary of what we can do by end of May:
- AWS: Publish two SKUs in the AWS Marketplace
  1) metered API (pay-as-you-go) — metered by API calls + token bands (maps to our hosted API).
  2) monthly reserved (Dedicated pool) — a time-based SKU (SRR monthly) with fixed vGPU pool size.
- AWS private listing: we can provide a private offer and BYOL guidance (onboarding runbook) but private (on-prem) package requires a separate support contract — doable but not as a marketplace SKU.

Notes / constraints:
- Metering granularity: AWS expects usage-counters. Our hosted API meters at token-level; we can translate to AWS usage records but need a short run to validate billing nuance (token fractionalization vs per-request).
- Regionization: us-east-1 + us-west-2 are straightforward; adding eu-west-1 will trigger GDPR checklist and an updated marketplace listing (Q3).

Next steps: internal SKU matrix + vendor billing mapping. Karthik — can you confirm co-sell packaging and whether we want a separate "co-sell managed" SKU (to surface to AWS sellers) vs the public metered listing? Vanessa — can you take point on the marketplace asset bundle? I'll draft the spreadsheet and send the first pass.

Thanks,
Marcus
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Sandeep Rao <srao@amazon.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 14 May 2026 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing scope & regional availability

Marcus / team — quick thoughts from GTM & co-sell perspective:

- Recommend three product bundles (clear names for seller-facing collateral):
  * Redwood Hosted (Metered) — for self-serve customers, surface on all three clouds.
  * Redwood Dedicated (Reserved Monthly) — targeted for enterprise buyers (support SLA, dedicated capacity).
  * Redwood Private (Private Offer / BYOL) — not public marketplace SKU; instead a catalog entry with a private offer flow + Managed Services add-on.

- Co-sell SKU: create a "Redwood Dedicated — Co-sell" private SKU that maps to an internal AWS seller playbook (discounting, lead routing, enablement). This is important for sales motions — AWS sellers need a discrete SKU to quote and attach incentives.

- GCP & Azure differences:
  * GCP: prefers per-minute compute metering for VM-based offerings; marketplace listing can accept time-based subscriptions. Metered REST APIs are supported but require a usage export integration.
  * Azure: has an Enterprise Agreement flow; for co-sell you often need the Marketplace listing + a managed offer that Azure sellers can attach.

Action items:
- Vanessa: finalize asset bundle (logos, screenshots, SKU descriptions).
- Laura: can you pre-check contract language for private offers (esp. data residency notes for eu deployments)?
- Marcus: share the SKU spreadsheet. I'll sketch co-sell playbook language for each cloud.

Thanks — Karthik
VP, GTM Strategy

From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sandeep Rao <srao@amazon.com>, Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@gcppartners.com>
Date: Fri, 15 May 2026 14:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing scope & regional availability

Thanks — attaching the first-pass SKU spreadsheet and a short draft playbook (see attachments). Highlights from the sheet:
- Proposed SKU codes:
  RW-HOST-MTR-001 (Hosted Metered) — available us-east-1, us-west-2 (expand to eu-west-1 in Q3)
  RW-DED-MTH-010 (Dedicated Monthly) — reserved vGPU pool, SLA tier 2, available initially in us-east-1 only
  RW-PRV-BYOL-000 (Private Offer) — listing entry, not public SKU; includes procurement checklist.

- Pricing notes: Metered maps to token buckets (example bands included). Dedicated is tiered by vGPU count; we included suggested MSRPs and partner margins.

- Marketplace asset checklist: images (2), technical doc pdf, 30-day trial terms, co-sell enablement packet.

Sandeep/Emily — are there any portal-specific fields we should pre-fill now (e.g., AWS: usage record namespace; GCP: billing export format)? I'd like to lock metadata so we don't get blocked on portal submission.

Cheers,
Vanessa Ortiz
Marketplace Programs Lead

Attachments: marketplace_sku_proposal_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), co-sell-playbook-draft.md (text)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Sandeep Rao <srao@amazon.com>
Date: Mon, 18 May 2026 16:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Marketplace listing scope & regional availability

Marcus / team — Laura here. Quick legal/controls note after reviewing Vanessa's attachment: 

- Data residency: If we publish in eu-west-1, we must update the Data Processing Addendum and include eu data flow controls in the listing. That adds an estimated 3-week lead time for the EU region.
- BYOL/private offer: include a short SLA addendum and a managed services SOW template. I attached a checklist to the shared drive (see link).
- Compliance proof points: for co-sell with AWS we should surface our SOC 2 Type II summary in the asset bundle (redacted where needed).

Suggested immediate moves:
1) Approve the two public SKUs (RW-HOST-MTR-001, RW-DED-MTH-010) for US regions only and proceed with AWS portal submission.
2) Hold eu listing until Data Processing Addendum is signed (target mid-June).

If no objections, I'll approve the wording for the private offer clause and Vanessa can proceed with upload.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
